property_summary: The transfer function always returns true when it does not revert.
The transfer function returns the same boolean value as the original contract when called with the same arguments.
The transfer function returns true when called with at least one receiver and valid token transfer calls.
The transfer function returns true when it completes successfully.
The transfer function always returns true when it does not revert.
When input arrays are empty, transfer() must still revert because it cannot call transferFrom on an empty loop.
When _tos length is 1, the return value of transfer is always true.
After a call to transfer with both arrays of equal length, the return value is always true.
The transfer function reverts when _tos is empty
When _tos and v arrays have equal length, transfer always returns true.
The transfer function should only succeed when the _tos array is non-empty.
After calling transfer with _tos.length > 0, the transfer should return true.
The transfer function should succeed (return true) when _tos.length > 0.
The transfer function should revert when _tos array is empty.

After a successful call to transfer, the PUBLIC storage variable 'transfer' (which is actually the function selector of the transfer function) should be its default value (false) because transfer is a function, not a state variable.
